name: Choujigen Douraku
source:
A legendary swordfighter goes up against the devil king!
To whom she will give her "first-time"? By whom will she be assaulted!?
The devil king, his subordinates, and even the mayor of the nearby village...!
The choices are in your actions!?

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE076574.html]DLsite English[/url]]
